segmentos.en:
"Tlamatini, run the **DESKTOP DIRECTOR** demo, please — a rich, " "fully-visible showcase that conducts the WHOLE desktop-UI trio in one flow: " "the **Windower** agent stages and moves a real window, the **Mouser** agent " "clicks into it to place the caret, and the **Keyboarder** agent types live " "text into it — then Windower makes the now-text-filled window dance " "around the screen. All driven from chat through the wrapped " "**chat_agent_windower** / **chat_agent_mouser** / **chat_agent_keyboarder** " "tools. " "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox in the toolbar before " "sending (ACPX is NOT required). Windows-only (Windower uses the Win32 API, " "Mouser uses PyAutoGUI). Run each window operation as a SEPARATE " "chat_agent_windower call and pause briefly between them so every move is " "visible. " "\n\n" "Step 0: open with one HTML banner — " "
" "

🎬 DESKTOP DIRECTOR 🎬

" "
Tlamatini — window, mouse and keyboard, conducted as one
. " "\n\n" "Step 1: launch Notepad so there is a window to direct — call " "**chat_agent_executer** with script='notepad' and non_blocking=true, then " "confirm the window is up with **chat_agent_window_present** " "(window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Step 2: STAGE the window center-screen — call **chat_agent_windower** " "with action='move_resize' and window_title='Notepad' and pos_x=360 and " "pos_y=180 and width=900 and height=560 and activate_after=true. Capture the " "promoted state/left/top/width/height. " "\n\n" "Step 3: focus the editing area with the MOUSE — call " "**chat_agent_mouser** with movement_type='click_at_window' and " "window_title='Notepad' and window_anchor='center' and button_click='left'. " "Capture the promoted fields located_via, clicked, end_posx, end_posy (this " "places the text caret so the next step types into the right window). " "\n\n" "Step 4: type live with the KEYBOARD — call **chat_agent_keyboarder** " "with input_sequence=\"'TLAMATINI', enter, 'in ixtli, in yollotl', enter, " "'the face, the heart -- that is wisdom', enter, enter, 'window, mouse and " "keyboard in concert.'\" and stride_delay=70 (the deliberate stride makes the " "keystrokes visible as they land). " "\n\n" "Step 5: now make the text-filled window DANCE — ONE chat_agent_windower " "call per move, each with window_title='Notepad' and activate_after=true, " "capturing the promoted state/left/top/width/height after each call: " "(a) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='left' (snaps to the left half); " "(b) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='right' (snaps to the right half); " "(c) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='top-right' (top-right quadrant); " "(d) action='maximize' (fills the screen); " "(e) action='restore' (back to normal size); " "(f) action='topmost' (pin it always-on-top). " "\n\n" "Step 6: enumerate the whole desktop with **chat_agent_windower** action='list' " "(leave window_title empty) and capture match_count (the number of open " "windows). " "\n\n" "Step 7: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Desktop Director Trace' and columns step, " "agent, action, detail, state, " "left, top, width, height — one row " "for the Mouser focus click (agent 'Mouser', action 'click_at_window', detail " "'located_via=, at (,)'), one row for the " "Keyboarder type (agent 'Keyboarder', action 'type', detail '4 lines, stride " "70ms'), then one row for EACH of the six window moves (a)..(f) (agent " "'Windower') using that call's promoted fields. Keep every body cell " "light-background with dark text (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or striped " "#f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 8: clean up — **chat_agent_windower** action='untopmost' and " "window_title='Notepad' (unpin), then **chat_agent_windower** action='close' " "and window_title='Notepad'. If a 'Save changes?' dialog appears, dismiss it " "WITHOUT saving via **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Step 9: close with one HTML banner that reuses the Step 0 gradient and prints, " "in big white letters, 'DESKTOP DIRECTED ✓', and underneath a one-line " "metric 'moves performed: 6 · open windows seen: · " "final state: · caret click: '. End with END-RESPONSE."

"Tlamatini, ejecuta la demo **DIRECTOR DEL ESCRITORIO**, por favor — una muestra completa " "y totalmente visible que dirige a TODO el trío de UI del escritorio en un solo flow: " "el agent **Windower** acomoda y mueve una ventana real, el agent **Mouser** " "hace clic dentro para colocar el cursor y el agent **Keyboarder** escribe en vivo " "texto en ella — luego Windower hace bailar la ventana, ya llena de texto, " "por la pantalla. Todo se controla desde el chat con los tools " "**chat_agent_windower** / **chat_agent_mouser** / **chat_agent_keyboarder** " "(wrappers). " "PRECONDICIONES: marca SÓLO la casilla **Multi-Turn** en la barra de herramientas antes " "de enviar (ACPX NO es necesario). Sólo para Windows (Windower usa la API " "Win32, Mouser usa PyAutoGUI). Haz cada operación de ventana como una llamada SEPARADA " "a chat_agent_windower y haz una pausa breve entre ellas para que cada movimiento " "sea " "visible. \n\n" "Paso 0: abre con un banner HTML " "—

🎬 DIRECTOR DEL ESCRITORIO " "🎬

Tlamatini — ventana, mouse y teclado, dirigidos como uno solo
. " "\n\n" "Paso 1: abre Notepad para que haya una ventana que dirigir — " "llama a **chat_agent_executer** con script='notepad' y non_blocking=true y " "luego confirma que la ventana está arriba con **chat_agent_window_present** " "(window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Paso 2: COLOCA la ventana al centro de la pantalla — llama a **chat_agent_windower** " "con action='move_resize' y window_title='Notepad' y pos_x=360 " "y pos_y=180 y width=900 y height=560 y activate_after=true. Captura los campos " "promovidos state/left/top/width/height. " "\n\n" "Paso 3: enfoca el área de edición con el MOUSE — llama a " "**chat_agent_mouser** con movement_type='click_at_window' y " "window_title='Notepad' y window_anchor='center' y button_click='left'. Captura " "los campos promovidos located_via, clicked, end_posx, end_posy (esto coloca " "el cursor de texto para que el siguiente paso escriba en la ventana correcta). \n\nPaso " "4" ": escribe en vivo con el TECLADO — llama a **chat_agent_keyboarder** con " "input_sequence=\"'TLAMATINI', enter, 'in ixtli, in yollotl', enter, 'the " "face, the heart -- that is wisdom', enter, enter, 'window, mouse and " "keyboard in concert.'\" y stride_delay=70 (el ritmo deliberado hace que las teclas " "se vean conforme van cayendo). \n\nPaso " "5" ": ahora haz BAILAR la ventana llena de texto — UNA llamada a chat_agent_windower por " "movimiento, cada una con window_title='Notepad' y activate_after=true, y " "captura los campos promovidos state/left/top/width/height después de cada llamada: (a) " "action='arrange' y arrange_mode='left' (se ajusta a la mitad izquierda); (b) " "action='arrange' y arrange_mode='right' (se ajusta a la mitad derecha); (c) " "action='arrange' y arrange_mode='top-right' (cuadrante superior derecho); (d) " "action='maximize' (llena la pantalla); (e) " "action='restore' (regresa al tamaño normal); (f) " "action='topmost' (la fija siempre encima). \n\nPaso " "6" ": enumera todo el escritorio con **chat_agent_windower** action='list' (deja " "window_title vacío) y captura match_count (el número de ventanas " "abiertas). \n\nPaso " "7" ": muestra una tabla HTML con class='exec-report-table' titulada " "'Rastro del director del escritorio' y con las columnas paso, " "agent, action, detalle, state, " "left, top, width, height — una fila para " "el clic de enfoque de Mouser (agent 'Mouser', action 'click_at_window', detalle " "'located_via=, en (,)'), una fila para lo " "que escribió Keyboarder (agent 'Keyboarder', action 'type', detalle '4 líneas, ritmo de " "70ms') y luego una fila para CADA uno de los seis movimientos de ventana (a)..(f) (agent " "'Windower') con los campos promovidos de esa llamada. Deja cada celda del cuerpo con " "fondo claro y texto oscuro (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; o rayado " "#f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Paso 8: limpia — **chat_agent_windower** action='untopmost' y " "window_title='Notepad' (la desfija) y luego **chat_agent_windower** action='close' y " "window_title='Notepad'. Si aparece un diálogo 'Save changes?', descártalo SIN " "guardar con **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Paso 9: cierra con un banner HTML que reutilice el gradiente del Paso 0 y muestre, en " "letras blancas grandes, 'ESCRITORIO DIRIGIDO ✓' y, debajo, una métrica de una " "línea 'movimientos hechos: 6 · ventanas abiertas vistas: · " "estado final: · clic del cursor: '. Termina con END-RESPONSE."

"Tlamatini, run the **BROWSER VIRTUOSO** demo, please — a rich, " "fully-visible showcase of the **Playwrighter** agent driving a REAL browser " "like a touch-typist: it types a search query character-by-character (you " "WATCH each key land), submits with the Enter KEY (not a click), follows the " "result into the article, reads it, pulls a page attribute, scrolls to the " "bottom with the keyboard, asserts, and captures three staged screenshots " "— all through its wrapped **chat_agent_playwrighter** tool. " "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox before sending (ACPX is " "NOT required). Playwright must be installed (`pip install playwright && " "playwright install`). The demo uses headless=false so you WATCH the browser " "type and navigate, and hold_open_seconds=12 so it stays visible for 12 " "seconds before it closes. " "\n\n" "Step 0: open with one HTML banner — " "
" "

🎤 BROWSER VIRTUOSO 🎤

" "
Tlamatini Playwrighter — a real browser types, submits and reads, key by key
. " "\n\n" "Step 1: call **chat_agent_playwrighter** with start_url='https://www.wikipedia.org' " "and headless=false and hold_open_seconds=12 and " "steps_json='[{\"action\":\"wait_for\",\"selector\":\"#searchInput\"}," "{\"action\":\"type\",\"selector\":\"#searchInput\",\"text\":\"Nahuatl\",\"delay\":140}," "{\"action\":\"screenshot\",\"path\":\"C:/Temp/virtuoso_1_typed.png\"}," "{\"action\":\"press\",\"key\":\"Enter\",\"selector\":\"#searchInput\"}," "{\"action\":\"wait_for\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\"}," "{\"action\":\"extract_text\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\",\"name\":\"article_title\"}," "{\"action\":\"extract_text\",\"selector\":\"#mw-content-text p\",\"name\":\"lead_paragraph\"}," "{\"action\":\"extract_attr\",\"selector\":\"link[rel=canonical]\",\"attr\":\"href\",\"name\":\"canonical_url\"}," "{\"action\":\"assert_text\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\",\"contains\":\"Nahuatl\"}," "{\"action\":\"assert_visible\",\"selector\":\"#bodyContent\"}," "{\"action\":\"screenshot\",\"path\":\"C:/Temp/virtuoso_2_article.png\",\"full_page\":false}," "{\"action\":\"press\",\"key\":\"End\"}," "{\"action\":\"wait\",\"ms\":800}," "{\"action\":\"screenshot\",\"path\":\"C:/Temp/virtuoso_3_bottom.png\",\"full_page\":true}]'. " "\n\n" "Step 2: parse the run result and capture the promoted fields status, " "final_url, steps_run, assert_result, plus the extracted values " "'article_title', 'lead_paragraph' and 'canonical_url' and the three " "screenshot paths. " "\n\n" "Step 3: render a STEP SCOREBOARD — a row of HTML chips of the form " "LABEL: a 'status: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #16a34a when ok, else #dc2626), an 'assert: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #16a34a when pass, else #dc2626), a 'steps: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #2563EB), and a 'shots: 3' chip (CHIP_BG #0FA3B1). " "\n\n" "Step 4: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Browser Virtuoso Result' and two columns field / " "value, one row each for start_url, final_url, status, steps_run, " "assert_result, article_title, canonical_url, and one row per screenshot path " "(virtuoso_1_typed / virtuoso_2_article / virtuoso_3_bottom). Keep every body " "cell light-background with dark text (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or " "striped #f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 5: render the extracted lead_paragraph inside an HTML " "
...lead_paragraph...
. " "\n\n" "Step 6: close with one HTML banner that reuses the Step 0 gradient and prints, " "in big white letters, 'VIRTUOSO PERFORMANCE ✓' (if status is ok and " "assert_result is pass) or 'VIRTUOSO: ' otherwise, and underneath a " "one-line metric 'article: · status: · " "assert: · steps: · shots: 3'. End " "with END-RESPONSE."
